references.text: The instruction to make the turban (מִצְנֶפֶת) for Aaron as part of the holy garments.
God's command to make the gold plate (צִיץ) with the inscription 'Holy to the Lord' that was to be attached to the turban.
The instruction to place the turban on Aaron's head and fasten the holy diadem to it.
A description of how the gold plate was made and attached to the turban with a blue cord.
Continuation of the consecration ceremony, where Moses also clothed Aaron's sons.
The turban was made of fine linen as part of the priestly garments.
